limits: No incorrect RA/RV/LA/LV/IVC label identity found.
Mitral/tricuspid figure13 panel ordering agrees with publisher caption.
Rib panelA arrow refers to hematoma; panelC arrow refers to minimal contour disruption; panelE is a long-standing consolidation example, not evidence of a current patient diagnosis.
Existing viewer wording explicitly separates publisher annotation location from independent anatomical validation.
Signal crops identify plots; full figures remain necessary for ECG, scale and acquisition context.
No certification, full anatomical coverage, measurement validity, or clinical suitability is established by this review.
